title: 海拔四千米的信
logline: 帕米尔高原垭口，马背邮递员艾力为边防士兵小杨送来大学录取通知书，一条邮路串起两代人的牵挂。

shots.narrationZh: 帕米尔高原，海拔四千米的风，吹了三十年。
shots.narrationEn: The wind of the Pamir Plateau, at 4,000 meters above sea level, has blown for thirty years.
shots.visual: A wide shot of the Pamir mountain pass, with snow-capped peaks stretching to the horizon, prayer flags fluttering in the wind, and a horse's hooves stepping on thick snow.
shots.ttsDirection: 沉缓厚重，带高原风的粗粝感，语速偏慢，四千米三十年重读，海拔四千米的风后稍作停顿

shots.visual: Aili, with a tanned face, wearing a dark green worn cotton coat and a fur hat, rides a horse towards the pass, smiling with white teeth visible, the mail bag on his shoulder covered in ice chips.

lines.en: Xiao Yang! Have you been waiting anxiously?

shots.ttsDirection: 沉稳平和，带风霜浸透的松弛感，语速平稳稍缓，三十重读，气息带高原粗粝感

shots.visual: Xiao Yang, wearing a military coat and a fleece hat, his face red from the cold wind, stands straight at the pass, eyes fixed on the mail bag on Aili's shoulder.

lines.en: Brother Aili! I've been waiting for you!

shots.ttsDirection: 带腼腆的急切感，语速稍快，等两个月重读，气息稍促，藏不住盼头

shots.visual: Aili takes off the ice-covered mail bag, picks the top frost-covered letter, and hands it to Xiao Yang, whose hands are trembling as he reaches out.

lines.zh: 最上层，你的大学录取通知书。
lines.en: The top one is your university admission letter.

shots.ttsDirection: 温和带暖意，语速平稳稍缓，递物处气息稍沉，藏不住的喜意

shots.narrationEn: At 4,000 meters above sea level, letters still arrive on time.
shots.visual: A close-up of Xiao Yang holding the admission letter, smiling with tears in his eyes, the JD Express logo and slogan 'Deliver Everywhere' appear at the bottom of the frame.
shots.ttsDirection: 兴奋上扬，语速稍快，照样到重读并带笑意，气息轻快明亮，藏不住雀跃
